properties.name: FIELD REPORT (flo2, 2026-09-18): a document review produced six design findings and a hosting analysis that stayed in chat; every loop signal is about nodes that exist, so a session that writes nothing reads as clean — and the accepted requirement covering this is satisfied only by a PLANNED capability
properties.source: flo2 reflow2_feedback.md, session 2026-09-18 (Anthony's own project; the agent triaging was this session, root-cause skill run at Anthony's prompt)
properties.statement: F0 in flo2's feedback, in the agent's words: 'A session that reasons about the design for an hour and writes none of it down is, to every detector, a clean session.' Its own cause: it generalised 'intent waits for the owner's word' into 'everything waits for permission'; a finding is the agent's observation and needs none. SEARCHED: req:session-memory-in-graph ('what a session learns is written to the graph as it is learned') is ACCEPTED and satisfied by cap:session-memory, status PLANNED. MEASURED: no served skill contains an instruction to write a finding before answering (grep over getting-started/skills: none); loop_status has no field about reads without writes; the usage ledger records every call per seat with the tool name, so reads-without-writes per session is computable today. The two missing legs are the instruction and the detector; the vocabulary (record_finding) exists.
